header.title: Assessment Actions
header.description: Control whether this role can create, edit and delete assessments, and manage assessment folders. All are on by default; turning one off hides that action everywhere it appears.

showCreateAssessment.label: Show "Create Assessment" button
showCreateAssessment.hint: Assessments list header, the assessment type picker, the sidebar "Create …" shortcuts and the "Create new assessment" option inside a slide.

showEditAssessment.label: Show "Edit Assessment" button
showEditAssessment.hint: The pencil button on Assessment Details that reopens the create wizard for an existing assessment.

showDeleteAssessment.label: Show "Delete Assessment" option
showDeleteAssessment.hint: The Delete entry in each assessment card’s "…" menu, on the Assessments, Evaluation Centre and Homework lists.

showManageFolders.label: Manage assessment folders
showManageFolders.hint: New folder, editing and deleting folders, dragging tests into folders and "Move to folder". When off, this role can still open folders and see their tests.
